name: IU Summer Music Clinic
org: Indiana University Jacobs School of Music, Jacobs Academy
what_you_do: You live on campus for four days. You rehearse and perform in a full orchestra or concert band with Jacobs faculty. You take sectionals and a master class. You also take one elective, such as conducting or jazz improvisation.
who_can_apply: Students currently in grades 8 to 12 who play in band or orchestra. Jazz band requires an audition on the first day.
pay_detail: 2027 estimates: residential tuition $800 (housing and meals); commuter tuition $550 (lunch and dinner); $100 non-refundable registration fee credited to tuition. Need-based financial aid is available.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 session June 16 to 19, 2027: registration opens mid-December 2026 and closes April 15, 2027; financial aid application due April 23, 2027; payment due May 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Online registration form plus the $100 registration fee, tuition by the payment deadline, then a Participant Agreement Form. Contact: musicsp@iu.edu.
notes: The 2027 prices are estimates. The student pays; this is not a job. The Jacobs Academy also lists other pre-college summer programs.
